== Original post ==

'''cough cheesy cough (baragwins and tibs)'''
* '''Author:''' Philippe "Climax_Giver" Parise
* '''Published:''' November 13, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' but works...simple, mass activation...  baragwins hidding.with the ishi tibsthe retrieve and hit when you want too

=== Strategy ===

simple retrive 3 your turn 3 his turn....with baragwins.....set it up fast.DONT DEPLOY KESSEL TILL THE END & get  leia a& han WOOPING ASS.....it rapes try it out

i dont care what you think of my deck.....if you rate it low.....fine but i will write back to you to counter your dumb @ss ideas about my deck...i am better than most of you(being kind) & KNOW BETTER also also....if you think it sucks well YOU SUCK so look at the deck read the cards & think about it REAL hard, & i am sure it will come to you ~Phil~
